measures.name: Public Measure GM
measures.ballotLanguage: Shall the City of Burlington, in Des Moines County, State of Iowa, enter into a loan agreement and issue general obligation bonds in an amount not exceeding $7,000,000 for the purpose of paying the cost, to that extent, of constructing, renovating and improving municipal swimming pool facilities?

notes: Supervisor contest is identical on every precinct's sample ballot (single seat, no district shown) - effectively at-large/countywide. Treasurer/Recorder/Attorney candidates appear without party labels on the ballot. No township offices on any precinct ballot. Burlington pool bond (Public Measure GM) appears only on Burlington precincts 1-8.
